subject: Coord: SOC2 + DPA walkthrough — propose rolling 2x30m slots
messages:
From: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@novum-finance.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC2 + DPA walkthrough — availability?

Hi Hannah,

We're getting ready for our vendor intake and would like to schedule a combined SOC2 controls walkthrough and DPA review. Our security team prefers a focused session rather than a single long meeting — would Redwood be open to two 30-minute focused blocks (one for controls/evidence mapping, one for DPA questions), followed by an optional 20-minute Q&A the same week?

Suggested windows (all times EDT):
- Tue Aug 6, 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed Aug 7, 09:00–11:00

Attendees on our side: me (Alice), Ben Carter (security lead), and procurement (procurement@novum-finance.com) — we can add more if helpful. Also, we may want to invite our pen-testing vendor (PenProbe) to the controls conversation — I can loop them in once we confirm.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend each block and whether you can provide a short pre-read?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Murphy
Sr. IT Risk Manager, Novum Finance
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@novum-finance.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA walkthrough — availability?

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run the split format you suggested. Proposal below (all times EDT):

Option A (preferred):
- Block 1: Controls & evidence mapping — Tue Aug 6, 10:30–11:00 (Redwood: Hannah + Laura)
- Block 2: DPA Q&A & data flows — Tue Aug 6, 11:15–11:45 (Redwood: Hannah + Compliance SME)
- Optional Q&A: Thu Aug 8, 10:00–10:20 (if follow-ups needed)

Option B (alternate):
- Block 1: Wed Aug 7, 09:15–09:45
- Block 2: Wed Aug 7, 10:00–10:30

I attached a short SOC2 checklist and the current DPA question set as a pre-read (SOC2-Checklist.pdf, DPA-Questions.xlsx). Please confirm which option works and who you'd like in each block. Also: if you'd like PenProbe on the controls call, we'll make space for them but will ask them to limit vendor-sensitive findings to a separate post-call readout.

If Option A looks good I'll send calendar invites with separate meeting descriptions so attendees can join the relevant block.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 + DPA — Novum availability (need staffing)

Irene/Laura — forwarding Novum's request. Can you confirm who can staff these two 30-min blocks? Prefer Laura on the controls mapping and Irene on DPA/data flow items, but if we need a Compliance SME for some DPA clauses we should include them. Also confirm if we want to include PenProbe on Block 1.

Quick answers please — want to lock invites for Tuesday morning.

Thanks,
Hannah
(quoted)
> From: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@novum-finance.com>
> We're getting ready for our vendor intake...
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC2 + DPA — Novum availability (need staffing)

Hannah — I can take the DPA/data flow block and join the controls call for context. Attaching the SOC2 checklist we've been using for intake and a short mapping doc I'll share on the call. Suggest we split Block 1 into two mini-segments: 12–15 minutes for control scope/evidence owners and 15–30 minutes for evidence examples and sources — keeps the call focused.

I also recommend we do not include PenProbe in the initial controls mapping; instead we can invite them to a post-walkthrough readout where they present findings to Novum's security team. That prevents any vendor-specific vulnerability discussion in the intake call.

I'll be available for Option A and can cover the DPA items with Laura as backup.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Murphy <alice.murphy@novum-finance.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novum-finance.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@novum-finance.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Aug 2029 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA walkthrough — confirm Option A

Hannah — Option A works for us. Please send separate calendar invites for the two 30-minute blocks and include the optional 20-minute Q&A slot on Thu in case it is needed.

Attendees confirmed from Novum: Alice Murphy, Ben Carter (security), procurement (procurement@novum-finance.com). Please include a short meeting agenda in each invite and attach the SOC2 checklist and DPA question set again. Also: could you provide the name and contact for your pen-test coordination lead (we'll coordinate vendor logistics separately)?

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
Alice
